title: Arcs and Sectors of Circles
seo_title: Arcs and Sectors – JSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the length of an arc and the area of a sector of a circle; find the perimeter of a sector. (summary of the NERDC JSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 3 maths worksheets on circles: circumference and area, arc length, sector area and the perimeter of a sector. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • An arc is part of the circumference. Arc length = θ ÷ 360 × 2πr.
  • A sector is a slice of the circle. Sector area = θ ÷ 360 × πr².
  • The perimeter of a sector = arc length + 2 radii.

Examples

Example

Sector of radius 7 cm and angle 90°

Arc = ¼ × 44 = 11 cm

Answer: Area = ¼ × 154 = 38.5 cm²

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the two radii in the perimeterAdd 2r to the arc.
Using 180° instead of 360°A full turn is 360°.
Using the diameterUse the radius.

items.e: θ/360 × 81π = 815π cm². So θ = 360 × 815 ÷ 81 = 72°.
